title: Remembering Allah While Waiting
paragraphs: Bilal duduk di ruang tunggu rumah sakit. Ibunya sedang menjalani operasi kecil. Ia melihat jam berulang kali dan tidak dapat memikirkan hal lain. Seorang pria tua duduk di sampingnya. Ia melihat Bilal khawatir. Pria itu berkata bahwa mengingat Allah membantunya saat menunggu lama. Bilal mencobanya. Ia mengucapkan dzikir sederhana dengan pelan. Ia berhenti terus melihat jam dan ponselnya.

Waktu tunggu itu tidak menjadi lebih singkat. Tetapi pikiran Bilal lebih tenang. Ia lebih sedikit memikirkan hal terburuk yang mungkin terjadi. Kemudian dokter membawa kabar baik. Bilal berterima kasih kepada pria tua itu. Ia belajar bahwa dzikir dapat membantunya menunggu dengan hati yang lebih tenang.
answerKey: Bilal sits in a hospital waiting room. His mother is having a small operation. He looks at the clock again and again and cannot think about anything else. An older man sits beside him. He sees that Bilal is worried. The man says that remembering Allah helps him during a long wait. Bilal tries it. He says simple words of remembrance quietly. He stops looking at the clock and his phone all the time. The wait does not become shorter. But Bilal's mind feels calmer. He thinks less about the worst thing that could happen. The doctor later brings good news. Bilal thanks the older man. He learns that remembrance can help him wait with a calmer heart.
